title: Concurrent invites can push a Collective past its 10 partners

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: invitePartnerSpace counts the hub's pending and accepted partner rows read beforehand, then inserts. validate_collective_partner (20270346009200_collective_partners.sql) checks consent but neither the count nor a lock on the hub, so two invites at once can both pass the cap. Fix: in the trigger, on insert, lock the hub row (for update) and refuse when 10 or more pending or accepted rows exist. Needs a migration.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const dir='supabase/migrations';const files=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.sql')).sort();let last='';for(const f of files){const t=fs.readFileSync(dir+'/'+f,'utf8');if(/function\\s+[\\w.]*validate_collective_partner/i.test(t))last=t}const i=last.search(/function\\s+[\\w.]*validate_collective_partner/i);const body=i<0?'':last.slice(i,i+6000);if(!/for update/i.test(body)||!/count\\(/i.test(body)){console.error('SCAN-1010: the partner trigger does not lock the hub and count, so concurrent invites pass the cap of 10');process.exit(1)}"
